item.title: Why Homebrew keeps losing Mac utilities to Apple's signing policy
item.description: Open-source Mac casks keep getting deprecated from Homebrew. The cause is Apple's $99/year signing requirement, enforced through brew audit.

item.title: WHPH vs Super Productivity
item.description:
I’ve been trying to figure out which productivity app actually fits my workflow. Both WHPH (Work Hard Play Hard) and Super Productivity keep coming up, so I thought it was worth comparing them properly.

WHPH (Work Hard Play Hard)

WHPH is a general-purpose productivity app. It does several things: tracks your tasks, monitors which apps you use and for how long, helps you build habits, and gives you a basic sense of where your time goes. The sync between desktop and mobile happens over your local network – no cloud, no account, just devices talking to each other.
